d: The Cabinet, chaired by Prime Minister Narendra Modi, has approved five major decisions worth Rs 19,934 crore. The government has introduced a new scheme to transform India into a manufacturing hub for cranes and bulldozers. Additionally, Rs 4,288 crore will be spent on constructing a second container terminal at the Kamarajar Port in Tamil Nadu. A new greenfield airport will be built at Dolu, near Silchar in Assam, at a cost of Rs 2,014 crore.
